events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in counterculture history, began on August 15, 1969.

angles.name: Summer of Love vibes
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since the mud, music, and peace. What's your top track from the legendary Woodstock '69 lineup?

events.title: Elvis Presley's passing anniversary
events.blurb: The music world remembers the passing of Elvis Presley, "The King of Rock and Roll," on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: On this day, we pay tribute to Elvis Presley, the legend who changed music forever. His legacy still shines bright.

events.title: Tupac Shakur's passing anniversary
events.blurb: Influential rapper Tupac Shakur was shot on September 7, 1996, in Las Vegas and died six days later.

angles.name: Tupac's Enduring Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur, whose music continues to resonate decades on. A true icon.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's passing anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, in London at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix: Guitar God
angles.copy: On this day, we honour the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work still inspires generations.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: That Iconic Crossing
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in history.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the powerful frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday LG
angles.copy: Our Kid is another year older! Happy 54th birthday to the legendary Liam Gallagher. Still got that swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo album 'Imagine' was released in the US on September 9, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine the Impact
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless message that resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: Original iPod anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first-generation iPod, revolutionising portable music, on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: The Device That Changed Music
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? Twenty-five years ago, Apple launched the device that put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changed how we listen forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is recognised globally as James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme songs, what's your favourite 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Visionary musician and peace activist John Lennon would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy and powerful songwriting of John Lennon. Imagine that.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedic genius John Cleese! Still making us laugh after all these years.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: The White Album Turns 58
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their eclectic 'White Album'. Which track is your favourite deep cut?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's passing anniversary
events.blurb: The world remembers Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen, who passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: On this day, we honour the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.
